name: Exp_CenterOfGravityOSMA
summary: This EA trades based on the Center of Gravity OSMA indicator, which is an oscillator-derived signal combining center of gravity calculations with double-smoothed moving averages. It opens buy positions when the OSMA histogram turns upward from a declining state and sell positions when it turns downward from a rising state, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CenterOfGravityOSMA指标进行交易，该指标是结合重心计算与双重平滑移动平均的振荡器信号。当OSMA直方图从下降转为上升时开多仓，从上升转为下降时开空仓，具有可配置的止损止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于CenterOfGravityOSMA指标的动量反转信号，该指标通过对价格的重心计算产生振荡值，再经过两轮平滑处理得到类似MACD的直方图。入场条件：当macd[1]<macd[2]（前期下降）且macd[0]>macd[1]（当前回升）时产生买入信号；当macd[1]>macd[2]（前期上升）且macd[0]<macd[1]（当前回落）时产生卖出信号。出场条件通过BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制是否在反向信号时平仓，同时使用固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit进行止损止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制手数比例，MMMode参数选择手数计算模式（固定手数或基于保证金的百分比）。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供的标准化下单函数，支持滑点控制（Deviation参数）和信号时间戳避免重复下单。该策略本质上是一个动量反转系统，捕捉短期振荡器方向的拐点。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum reversal signals from the CenterOfGravityOSMA indicator, which generates oscillator values through center of gravity price calculations processed with two rounds of smoothing to produce a MACD-like histogram. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when macd[1]<macd[2] (prior decline) and macd[0]>macd[1] (current recovery), indicating an upward momentum shift; a sell signal is generated when macd[1]>macd[2] (prior advance) and macd[0]<macd[1] (current decline), indicating a downward momentum shift. Exit conditions are controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose boolean parameters that determine whether opposite signals close existing positions, combined with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels for risk management. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter controlling lot size ratio, with MMMode selecting between fixed lot size or margin-based percentage calculation. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library providing standardized order placement functions with slippage control (Deviation parameter) and signal timestamps to prevent duplicate orders. The strategy is fundamentally a momentum reversal system capturing short-term oscillator turning points.

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于振荡器拐点的动量反转交易具有明确的方向性
支持独立的买入/卖出开仓和平仓控制，灵活性高，可根据市场条件单独启用或禁用
使用NewBar检查避免同一K线内重复交易，减少过度交易和信号噪音
具有固定止损止盈设置，提供基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on oscillator turning point momentum reversal trading with definite directional signals
Supports independent buy/sell open and close controls, offering high flexibility to enable or disable based on market conditions
Uses NewBar check to prevent repeated trading within the same bar, reducing overtrading and signal noise
Includes fixed stop loss and take profit settings, providing a basic risk control framework
cons: 止损止盈使用固定点数而非ATR动态计算，在不同波动率环境下适应性差
缺少加仓和仓位追踪机制（如移动止损），盈利交易可能因回撤而损失利润
指标参数较多且缺乏自适应机制，在市场状态变化时容易失效
没有考虑点差和手续费对交易成本的影响，在小周期交易中可能侵蚀利润
双重平滑可能导致信号滞后严重，错过最佳入场时机
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit use fixed points rather than ATR-based dynamic calculation, poor adaptability across different volatility environments
Lacks position addition and trailing stop mechanisms, profitable trades may lose gains due to pullbacks
Many indicator parameters without self-adaptive mechanism, prone to failure when market regime changes
Does not account for spread and commission impacts on trading costs, which may erode profits in shorter timeframes
Double smoothing may cause significant signal lag, missing optimal entry timing
improvements: 将固定止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，以适应不同市场波动率环境
增加移动止损（Trailing Stop）功能，保护已盈利仓位并让利润充分奔跑
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高点差时段和不利时段开仓
考虑增加指标参数的自适应优化机制，根据近期市场状态动态调整平滑周期
improvements_en: Replace fixed stop loss/take profit with ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to different market volatility environments
Add trailing stop functionality to protect profitable positions and allow profits to run further
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid opening positions during high-spread and unfavorable periods
Consider adding self-adaptive optimization for indicator parameters, dynamically adjusting smoothing periods based on recent market conditions

risk_points: 固定止损1000点/止盈2000点数值较大，在某些品种上可能超出合理范围导致实际无保护
振荡器反转信号在趋势行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺少最大回撤控制和单日最大亏损限制，极端行情下可能遭受重大损失
依赖自定义指标CenterOfGravityOSMA，若指标文件缺失则EA初始化失败
risk_points_en: Fixed SL 1000/TP 2000 points are large values that may exceed reasonable ranges on some instruments, resulting in practically no protection
Oscillator reversal signals can produce frequent false signals during trending markets, leading to consecutive losses
Lacks maximum drawdown control and daily loss limit, potentially suffering significant losses in extreme market conditions
Depends on custom indicator CenterOfGravityOSMA; if the indicator file is missing, EA initialization fails
